caption: A woodcutter with a long handled axe chops down a thick tree in a forest.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A woodcutter with a long handled axe chops down a thick tree in a forest. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The woodcutter must be positioned securely around the tree to maintain balance during the chopping motion.
The axe must be swung with sufficient force to create a deep, clean cut through the tree trunk.
Visible separation of the tree trunk must occur as the cut progresses deeper into the wood.
The woodcutter must adjust stance and position as the tree begins to lean or fall to ensure safety and control.
